why: Both land on the convenient-drugstore, profit-per-customer-visit hedgehog and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 1 commits to exiting food service entirely on a firm (about five-year) deadline and exiting the discount stores, which matches the key's stop-doing decision, whereas Analysis 2 only holds the free-standing restaurants and puts the lunch counters on a test. Analysis 2 is somewhat better calibrated, with an explicit confidence statement and clearer flags on unproven links, but Analysis 1 gives the leader the more decisive and correct direction.
